title: Settings
description: Instance-wide settings. Every field has a sensible default; change only what you need.
localOnlyHint: Open Canopy from the local network to change this.

ownPage.mail: Email (SMTP) settings are on the Email page.

sessionLifetimeDays.label: Session lifetime (days)
sessionLifetimeDays.description: A session ends this long after sign-in, even if it is used.

idleTimeoutMinutes.label: Idle timeout (minutes)
idleTimeoutMinutes.description: A session unused for this long ends.

passwordMinLength.label: Minimum password length
passwordMinLength.description: Applies to new passwords; existing ones keep working.

checkBreachedPasswords.label: Refuse breached passwords
checkBreachedPasswords.description: Checks new passwords against Have I Been Pwned (only 5 characters of a hash leave the server).

lockoutThreshold.label: Failed attempts before lockout
lockoutThreshold.description: Consecutive failures on one account before it is locked.

lockoutMinutes.label: Lockout duration (minutes)
lockoutMinutes.description: How long a locked account stays locked.

ipBlockThreshold.label: Failures before blocking an address
ipBlockThreshold.description: Failed sign-ins and codes from one address, all accounts together.

ipBlockMinutes.label: Address block window (minutes)
ipBlockMinutes.description: Window counting failures, and how long the address stays blocked.

notifyNewSignIn.label: Email on new sign-in
notifyNewSignIn.description: Users with an email get a notice when they sign in from a new device or address.

retentionDays.label: Keep events for (days)
retentionDays.description: Older events are deleted once a day; the purge itself is recorded.

maintenance.label: Maintenance mode
maintenance.description: Only the local network can use Canopy; everyone else sees a maintenance page. Can only be changed from the local network.

mailRetentionDays.label: Keep sent emails for (days)
mailRetentionDays.description: Recipient, subject and content of sent or failed emails are deleted after this many days.

colorTheme.label: Color theme
colorTheme.description: Accent color of the whole interface, for everyone.

defaultMode.label: Default mode
defaultMode.description: Light or dark for people who have not chosen on their device; System follows their device.

defaultLocale.label: Default language
defaultLocale.description: Used when a visitor has not chosen a language and their browser's languages are not available.
